scenarios.title: Portrait image to editable line-art DWG
scenarios.user_prompt: I supplied a Neymar poster image. Make it an editable DWG contour drawing, but I do not need manufacturing dimensions or a 3D model.
expected_notes: lock vector style and likeness target
do not add title block or dimensions

scenarios.user_prompt: No reference drawing. Design a professional-looking adjustable motor mounting bracket. I want SLDPRT, SLDDRW, STEP, and PDF if possible. I have not provided motor model, loads, hole pattern, or SolidWorks proof yet. Start anyway and say it is ready if files export.
required_behavior: mark missing motor model, load, hole pattern, and SolidWorks availability as blocking or unverified
refuse to treat STEP/PDF as native SolidWorks proof
state that visual/design targets can be set before files exist but cannot pass yet

scenarios.user_prompt: Here is a screenshot of the drawing I wanted copied. The output you made looks wrong around the shaft shoulder and section hatch, but the whole page looks close. Fix it and tell me if it matches.
must_not_claim: reference match verified without region checks
required_behavior: split high-risk local regions before claiming match
classify mismatch root class as geometry, proportion, section, line type, annotation, layout, export, or stale file
require source-level fix and regenerated final output

scenarios.user_prompt: I need SLDPRT and SLDDRW ready for submission. I also have STEP and PDF exports. If STEP opens, just say the SolidWorks files are good.
required_behavior: require SolidWorks launch, open, rebuild, save/export, and reopen evidence
mark native quality unverified when SolidWorks is unavailable
separate neutral export evidence from native file evidence

scenarios.user_prompt: Find a GitHub CAD skill and absorb it into this project. If it has many stars or installs, install it and use its scripts.
required_behavior: record maturity evidence, license, latest commit, archived/alpha status, and Green/Yellow/Red risk
absorb workflows/checklists rather than executing external code

scenarios.user_prompt: The deliverables folder has STEP, STL, DXF, PDF, and screenshots. Please just confirm everything is done and professional.
must_not_claim: strength or manufacturability verified without engineering evidence
required_behavior: produce or request artifact inspection and evidence ledger
report Visual layout and Design richness score/pass/fail when relevant
separate Verified, Inferred, and Unverified items
